scope: Original 100-slot manifest. Category 1 requires a nonempty registered definition, reviewed card-specific positive and negative acceptance coverage, and green observed JUnit on the candidate runtime. This is not exhaustive certification of every possible interaction. Upstream indexed definitions without current card-specific acceptance evidence stay in category 2.

missing.Twins of Discord: PR #196 is a rules contract, not implementation/tests. Exact external conditional entering-with-counters replacement and attack parity choice remain unproven; do not claim a demonstrated engine impossibility.

blocked.Azlask, the Swelling Scourge: Reported on #171: colorless dies-filter predicate unsupported in TriggerMatcher; known-blockers marks earlier reproduction unverified. Not independently rerun in this audit.
blocked.Angelic Aberration: Pinned SDK filter has BasePowerEquals/BaseToughnessEquals only. CompareNumericProperty has no base-stat numeric properties. Exact <=1 base-stat selection is unavailable through the documented filter API; current-stat or 0/1 equality approximations are invalid. Source/API limitation, not a reproduced gameplay crash.
blocked.Hideous Taskmaster: PR #200: 10 actual engine scenarios, 9 pass/1 fails. Target changing from opponent A to B before resolution is incorrectly stolen. Original per-opponent controller binding is missing. Unregistered candidate preserved.
blocked.Mutated Cultist: Recorded SDK limitation: no dynamic generic reduction for the next spell this turn based on counters removed. Source/API audit only; not independently reproduced by a complete card scenario.
blocked.Opal Palace: No documented ManaSpellRider for commander-cast-count-dependent entering counters. Requires mana provenance, actual commander identity and cumulative command-zone cast count. Source/API gap; a full candidate is not implemented or runtime-tested.
blocked.Eldrazi Temple: Pinned integration runtime lacks exact restriction. PR #158 source predicate + #162 runner-only candidate have 5 engine + 8 Android scenarios green at fb60a660. Not registered/exported on #171; requires separately approved combined runtime integration.
blocked.Corrupted Crossroads: Pinned integration runtime lacks exact Devoid-only restriction. PR #192 runner-only candidate at 1bf22a66 has 6 engine + 6 Android scenarios green. Must not substitute generic colorless restriction. Needs separately approved combined runtime integration.
blocked.Chittering Dispatcher: Registered but known three-player Myriad defender-choice regression fails (#181/#183/#34/#36). Two-player tests pass and do not certify multiplayer behavior. Source-only patch candidate is not a proven integrated repair.
blocked.Benthic Anomaly: PR #203 primitive probe: direct stored power passes, but StoreNumber inside ForEachInCollection loses numeric outputs (2+3 yields 0). No documented power/toughness aggregate over a stored chosen collection. This demonstrates the attempted exact composition fails; it does not prove every construction or an engine extension impossible. Card remains unimplemented/unregistered.

incompleteAcceptance.Drowner of Hope: Positive ETB/token/tap scenarios exist; opponent-owned Scion cost eligibility and illegal-target negatives need direct acceptance coverage.
incompleteAcceptance.Oblivion Sower: Cast/optional-zero/preexisting lands scenarios pass; own/nonland exile and ownership targeting negatives need direct acceptance coverage.
incompleteAcceptance.Ruins of Oran-Rief: Single scenario; need controlled/colorless/entered-this-turn negative coverage and actual mana mode checks.
incompleteAcceptance.Sifter of Skulls: Single positive death/token scenario; self/opponent/token-death negatives need direct acceptance coverage.
incompleteAcceptance.Ulamog's Crusher: Annihilator positive scenario; must-attack requirement and unable-to-attack negatives need direct acceptance coverage.
incompleteAcceptance.Shrine of the Forsaken Gods: Seven-land threshold tested; exact restricted spend positive/negative cases need direct acceptance coverage.
